COMMAND REFERENCE / 001

Before the silence.

Command the Western Alliance through ten minutes of escalating global war. Preserve your cities, destroy opposing forces, and decide when to release your nuclear arsenal.

01 / Deploy

During DEFCON 5–4, choose assets on the left and click the western sector. Each asset uses deployment credits.

02 / Command

Click a friendly unit, then click a destination or an enemy to engage. Units automatically attack valid targets in range at DEFCON 3 or below.

03 / Release

At DEFCON 1, select a silo, submarine or bomber, click Arm nuclear strike, then click the target. Silos also intercept incoming warheads.

04 / Survive

Score: +4 per destroyed enemy unit, +1 per million enemy casualties, −2 per million allied casualties. Highest score at ceasefire wins.

Fighters engage aircraft. Battleships engage ships and aircraft. Bombers engage ships and ground installations. Submarines engage ships. Silos defend against aircraft and missiles. Carriers defend fleets.
